say:1:1122507001:1.text: A <style="highlight">group of bounty hunters</style> has come to town in the past few days. I heard that the leader is a sharpshooter.
say:1:1122507001:1.source_cn: 这两天镇上又来了一伙<style=highlight>...

say:2:1122507002:1.text: I don't know how tough they are... I've been meaning to send someone to scope them out. Are you free by any chance?
say:2:1122507002:1.source_cn: 也不知道究竟有多厉害……得找人去探探底细。你有空吗？
say:2:1122507002:1.male: I don't know how tough they are... I've been meaning to send someone to scope them out. Are you free by any chance?
say:2:1122507002:1.female: I don't know how tough they are... I've been meaning to send someone to scope them out. Are you free by any chance?

say:3:1122507003:1.text: Don't worry. I'm not asking you to cozy up to them and find out their deep dark secrets. I'm done with stuff like that.
say:3:1122507003:1.source_cn: 放心，我不是要你去收情报费——那种勾当，我早就不干了！
say:3:1122507003:1.male: Don't worry. I'm not asking you to cozy up to them and find out their deep dark secrets. I'm done with stuff like that.
say:3:1122507003:1.female: Don't worry. I'm not asking you to cozy up to them and find out their deep dark secrets. I'm done with stuff like that.

say:4:1122507004:1.text: I just want to know if they're the troublesome sort. If they're alright and want to earn some coin, maybe they'll be willing to join up.
say:4:1122507004:1.source_cn: 我只是想知道他们有没有恶意。要是他们能力不错，又想挣点...

say:0:1122509001:0.text: These guys are the worst! Can't believe they're robbing ordinary folks!
say:0:1122509001:0.source_cn: 这群人太恶劣了！连普通镇民也要抢劫！

say:1:1122509002:0.text: Magister, let's make them regret their life decisions!
say:1:1122509002:0.source_cn: 主人，快给他们点颜色瞧瞧！
say:1:1122509002:0.male: Magister, let's make them regret their life decisions!
say:1:1122509002:0.female: Magister, let's make them regret their life decisions!

say:0:1122510001:0.text: You bloody sandsakes snuck up on us when we weren't ready! What kind of heroes are you?!
say:0:1122510001:0.source_cn: 你这家伙，居然趁人不备偷袭，算哪门子英雄好汉！
say:0:1122510001:0.male: You bloody sandsakes snuck up on us when we weren't ready! What kind of heroes are you?!
say:0:1122510001:0.female: You bloody sandsakes snuck up on us when we weren't ready! What kind of heroes are you?!

say:1:1122510002:0.text: Fight me fair and square! If you beat me in marksmanship, I'll admit defeat!
say:1:1122510002:0.source_cn: 有本事就堂堂正正地和我对决！我也不刁难你，只要你的枪法...
say:1:1122510002:0.male: Fight me fair and square! If you beat me in marksmanship, I'll admit defeat!
say:1:1122510002:0.female: Fight me fair and square! If you beat me in marksmanship, I'll admit defeat!

say:0:1122511001:0.text: Damn... You're pretty accurate. Can't believe there's someone like you in Alkali... See ya!
say:0:1122511001:0.source_cn: 你……你的枪法居然这么准！咸水镇真是藏龙卧虎……我可不...
say:0:1122511001:0.male: Damn... You're pretty accurate. Can't believe there's someone like you in Alkali... See ya!
say:0:1122511001:0.female: Damn... You're pretty accurate. Can't believe there's someone like you in Alkali... See ya!

say:1:1122511002:0.text: They left just like that? Ah! Everything fell out of my pack!
say:1:1122511002:0.source_cn: ……他们就这样走了？可是我包里的东西……全都掉出来了！

say:2:1122511003:0.text: Magister, let's help her with her pack.
say:2:1122511003:0.source_cn: 主人，我们帮她整理一下吧。
say:2:1122511003:0.male: Magister, let's help her with her pack.
say:2:1122511003:0.female: Magister, let's help her with her pack.

say:0:1122512001:0.text: Thank you for chasing away the bad guys and helping me with my pack!
say:0:1122512001:0.source_cn: 谢谢……谢谢你！赶走了那些坏人，还帮我收拾包裹！
say:0:1122512001:0.male: Thank you for chasing away the bad guys and helping me with my pack!
say:0:1122512001:0.female: Thank you for chasing away the bad guys and helping me with my pack!

say:1:1122513001:1.text: Another group of punks? The law and order in Alkali stinks as much as terrabird scat.
say:1:1122513001:1.source_cn: 又是一群作恶之人？咸水镇的治安，果然不是一时半刻就能好...

say:2:1122513002:1.text: Hey, don't look at me like that. Ever since I fought you, I've behaved. I mean, I'm not afraid of you or anything.
say:2:1122513002:1.source_cn: 别这样看着我。自打与你一战之后，我就改邪归正了——当然...
say:2:1122513002:1.male: Hey, don't look at me like that. Ever since I fought you, I've behaved. I mean, I'm not afraid of you or anything.
say:2:1122513002:1.female: Hey, don't look at me like that. Ever since I fought you, I've behaved. I mean, I'm not afraid of you or anything.

say:3:1122513003:1.text: Thanks to you, the town is right as rain.
say:3:1122513003:1.source_cn: 这回多亏了你，镇上才没出大乱子。
say:3:1122513003:1.male: Thanks to you, the town is right as rain.
say:3:1122513003:1.female: Thanks to you, the town is right as rain.
